entities.name: Psb30/Ycf12
observations: A 34-residue protein sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q6B8L0, annotated as Photosystem II reaction center protein Psb30.
The protein is annotated as a single-pass chloroplast thylakoid membrane protein and likely stabilizes the Photosystem II reaction center.
The query sequence has GRAVY 1.3235, theoretical pI 8.50, predicted molecular weight 3,648.5 Da, and charge at pH 7 of +0.50.
Pfam PSII_Ycf12 (PF05969.17) spans residues 1–34 with i-Evalue 7.9e-18.
Homologs P51385 and Q1XDA2 show 73.5% identity over 100% of the sequence and carry the same Psb30 annotation.

entities.name: Photosystem II
observations: Psb30/Ycf12 is a core subunit of Photosystem II and is thought to help stabilize the reaction center in the thylakoid membrane.

entities.name: Photosynthetic electron transport
observations: The protein is a structural component of Photosystem II, placing it in the photosynthetic light-reaction electron-transfer apparatus.
